dragonstone.title: Dragonstone
dragonstone.description: The **Dragonstone** is a stone tablet that depicts a map of Skyrim, marked with the locations of Dragon burial mounds. It was crafted following the Dragon War and was meant to document the burial of the Dragon-Lords in Skyrim for when Alduin returned. It was created in the days that followed Alduin's defeat in the Dragon War. It was protected by the Keeper of the Dragonstone, a Draugr, in his tomb at Bleak Falls Barrow.
